title.en: Children and Young Persons (Juvenile Rehabilitation Centres and Places of Safety) Order 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Children and Young Persons (Juvenile Rehabilitation Centres and Places of Safety) Order 2012 and shall come into operation on 15th June 2012.

heading.en: Juvenile rehabilitation centres and places of safety

text.en:
3. The following Orders are revoked:
(a)the Children and Young Persons (Approved Schools and Approved Homes) Order 1999 (G.N. No. S 536/99); and
(b)the Children and Young Persons (Approved School and Approved Home) Order 2006 (G.N. No. S 206/2006).
